name: San Ferdinando di Puglia (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Ferdinando di Puglia (a comet above fields on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of San Ferdinando di Puglia, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: San Ferdinando di Puglia arms — comet above fields on blue, crowned, within branches
